name: fshttp-studio
description: Run a single FsHttp request from an F# script and see the response rendered.

fshttpStudio.dotnetPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a `dotnet` executable that carries a .NET 10 SDK or newer. Leave this empty to detect `dotnet` on your `PATH` automatically. Set it when your SDK is not on `PATH`, or to pin a specific installation.

scripts.build:fable:extension: dotnet tool run fable src/host --outDir out
scripts.build:fable:webview: dotnet tool run fable src/webview --outDir out/webview
scripts.compile: dotnet tool restore && npm run build:companion && npm run build:fable:extension && npm run build:fable:webview && npm run build:bundle
